newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks mostly off at midday, retailers firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks mostly off at midday, retailers firm.

text.p: U.S. stocks were mostly weaker at Monday's midsession, with the lone pockets of strength coming from retailing and technology stocks.
The Dow industrials fell 36 to 6486. Sears, Roebuck & Co was among the very few components in the plus column.
Sears and other retail stocks were benefitting from what appears to be a robust start to the Christmas shopping season, which began in earnest with the Thanksgiving holiday weekend.
"The whole retail sector seems to be energized today," said Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co.
